name: premium-web
description: Build premium, studio-quality web pages as several competing candidates you browse and pick from in a Claude Code mod pane, then finish the winner with a calibrated critic loop, a mandatory signature 'wow' moment and image generation.

candidateCount.title: Candidates per premium build
candidateCount.description: How many materially different candidate sites the premium-web skill builds before you pick one (1-6, default 3). A number in your request, such as 'build 5 candidates', overrides this for that run.
